ANALYTICS.TITLE: Analytics
ANALYTICS.SUBTITLE: The last {days} days, compared with the {days} days before.

CHART.TITLE: Conversations by day
CHART.EMPTY: No conversations in this period yet.
CHART.NOTE: Each bar counts the conversations someone replied in that day. A conversation over several days counts on each of them.
CHART.AI_TOTAL: AI agent replied, day by day
CHART.TEAM_TOTAL: Your team replied, day by day

REPORTS.TITLE: Detailed reports
REPORTS.SUBTITLE: Every number in full, with filters and downloads.

ITEMS.LIVE: Open conversations, who is online and the busiest hours of the week.
ITEMS.CONVERSATIONS: Conversations, messages, reply and solve times over any period.
ITEMS.AGENTS: Each person: conversations, time to first reply and solved.
ITEMS.TEAMS: The same numbers for each team.
ITEMS.INBOXES: The same numbers for each channel: chat, email, WhatsApp.
ITEMS.LABELS: Conversations by label, to see what customers ask about.
ITEMS.AI_AGENT: Conversations your AI agent solved or handed to your team, over time.
ITEMS.RATING: Every customer rating with its comment, by person and channel.
ITEMS.TARGETS: Conversations that missed a reply-time target, and why.

PEOPLE.TITLE: Your team
PEOPLE.EMPTY: Nobody on your team replied in this period.

AI.STAYED_TOTAL: Stayed with the AI agent, day by day
AI.HANDED_TOTAL: Handed to your team, day by day
AI.NOTE: Each bar counts the conversations your AI agent replied in that day; amber is the part it handed to your team.
AI.EMPTY: Your AI agent had no conversations in this period.

TEAM.EMPTY: Your team replied in no conversation in this period.
TEAM.NO_TEAMS: No team had conversations in this period.

RATING.EMPTY: No ratings in this period yet.
RATING.NO_COMMENTS: No comments with the ratings in this period.
